Join Us in Building the Future
of AI Agents & Applications

Comet is a remote-first, #Collaborative company where employees are cross-culturally diverse and work together as a team towards a collective goal. We strive to find a good balance between work and personal life and help our employees achieve both their professional and personal goals. Quality is important to us and we take the time to get things right.

Risk-taking and innovation are core to our culture which enables us to continue to build on the things that no other company has. #CustomerFocus and being data-driven helps us achieve #Excellence at all levels. Our innovative products and #ThoughtLeadership are well known in the AI engineering space. We take our work seriously, but we also know how to have fun. We are proud of the fact that our team has members in over 14 countries around the world and everyone looks forward to interacting with each other by attending monthly team get-togethers and annual offsites. We believe that location doesn’t determine your potential. That’s why we hire the best talent, no matter where they are located in the world. Our employees can work in a hybrid mode from our offices in NYC and TLV, to meet their needs and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
